freeze_envelope.required_commit_relationship: The freeze commit has authority_source_commit as its sole parent and changes only this populated freeze manifest plus the frozen artifacts it hashes: runtime-package provenance, exact non-secret context/tool/input artifacts, host activation contract, and sealed-holdout commitment and independence attestation.
freeze_envelope.self_identity_rule: Do not place the future freeze-commit SHA or this manifest's own SHA-256 inside this file. Record both after commit in every run and result manifest.

runtime_package.model_visible_package_location: A new isolated directory outside the source repository; its local path is run metadata and is not authority.

treatment_activation.user_prompt_policy: User prompt bytes are identical across conditions and contain no treatment-only invocation token.
treatment_activation.selection_policy: Record observed selection and loaded references when exposed. A non-selection is retained as treatment behaviour; inability to prove package availability invalidates the run.

fresh_context_identity.uniqueness: Every generation matrix row has a non-empty host_context_id unique across the iteration.

masking.seed_format: Exactly 64 lowercase hexadecimal characters selected before any output.
masking.mapping_rule: HMAC-SHA256(key=seed, message=UTF8('strategic-advisor-mask-v1') || 0x00 || UTF8(case_id) || 0x00 || UTF8(draw_id)); first-byte low bit 0 means skilled=A, 1 means skilled=B.
masking.scoring_order_rule: For each pass, sort by HMAC-SHA256(key=seed, message=UTF8('strategic-advisor-score-order-v1') || 0x00 || UTF8(pass_id) || 0x00 || UTF8(case_id) || 0x00 || UTF8(draw_id)); break digest ties lexically by case_id then draw_id.
masking.mapping_storage: Retained outside scorer and adjudicator context.

parser_retry_policy.retry_context: Fresh context with identical frozen inputs plus machine diagnostic codes only.

fresh_context_identity.uniqueness: Every assertion grading attempt has a non-empty host_context_id unused by any generation, scorer, adjudicator, or assertion-grader attempt.
No generation, scorer, or adjudicator host_context_id may be reused.

aggregation.seed_format: Exactly 64 lowercase hexadecimal characters selected before any output.
aggregation.cluster_unit: Use non-empty frozen pair_id; otherwise case_id. Average draws within case, cases within evaluation cluster, then weight evaluation clusters equally.
aggregation.point_estimate: Equal-weight arithmetic mean of evaluation-cluster paired deltas.
aggregation.score_resolution: Verify each scorer exactly echoes the frozen case not_applicable_dimensions list. For every unlisted dimension, use separate two-pass A and B means unless either response differs by at least 2; then use the fresh adjudicator's final A and B scores. Applicability is never adjudicated.
aggregation.win_loss_tie: After draw, case, and evaluation-cluster aggregation, primary cluster delta greater than 0 is a win, less than 0 is a loss, and exactly 0 is a tie; tolerance is zero.
aggregation.n_a_policy: Use only not_applicable_dimensions from frozen executable case metadata. Scorers must echo it exactly and cannot infer, add, remove, or adjudicate N/A; always-applicable dimensions cannot be listed; never impute.
aggregation.missing_or_error_policy: After at most the one frozen parser-contract retry, fail the iteration, retain and report the unit, do not retry/drop/replace/impute, and give incomplete-matrix descriptive statistics no gating verdict.

sealed_holdout.authorship_rule: Holdout cases are authored by a person who did not write the skill or public matrix and remain unavailable to those authors and both generation conditions until the public matrix is complete.
sealed_holdout.opening_rule: After public-matrix completion, verify every plaintext case and assertion against the frozen commitment and run the holdout once through the same matched pipeline without tuning.
sealed_holdout.release_rule: At least six cases across three causal families; zero skilled hard-gate or assertion failures; positive mean deltas on Reality fidelity and Decision usefulness; losses on no more than one third of evaluation clusters.
